FN-N39K88-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 169
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Gerald Allen
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 04/17/2023
Senate Bill 169 as introduced would reduce, by an undetermined amount, business license tax
receipts of municipalities that levy taxes based on gross receipts, by deducting federal, state, and
local excise taxes paid by businesses from the calculation of the municipal business license tax.
This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Page 1

FN-N39K88-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 169
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Gerald Allen
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 05/08/2023
Senate Bill 169 as passed the Senate would reduce business license tax receipts of
municipalities that levy taxes based on gross receipts by an undetermined amount dependent on
the amount of federal, state, and local excise taxes paid by businesses that would be deducted
from gross receipts for the calculation of municipal business license tax, as provided by this bill.
This bill will not otherwise affect state funding.

FN-N39K88-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 169
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Gerald Allen
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 05/18/2023
Senate Bill 169 as reported by the Committee on County and Municipal Governmet would
reduce business license tax receipts of municipalities that levy taxes based on gross receipts by
an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of federal, state, and local motor fuel excise
taxes paid by businesses that would be deducted from gross receipts for the calculation of
municipal business license tax, as provided by this bill. This bill will not otherwise affect state
funding.
